questions.stem: In a problem set, a planner summarizes the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: Date, address, subject, body, closing, signature

questions.explanation: Standard order is date, address, subject, body, closing, signature. The key is A, "Date, address, subject, body, closing, signature". Option B ("Body, date, subject, closing") is wrong: scrambles the order. Option C ("Signature, date, body") is wrong: starts with signature. Option D ("Subject only, no body") is wrong: omits essential parts.
questions.hint: Date, address, subject, body, close, sign
